text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Prime Minister Andris Shkele discussed the government situation with the leaders of leading parties For Fatherland and Freedom/LNNK and Latvia's Way. Amid talk of a government resignation, he will make his views known later today at a news conference.
- Latvia's Way is confident the government can continue to work until the next planned elections.
- For Fatherland and Freedom was more pessimistic, saying it will be difficult to keep the present government in power.
